text: Program Description Training Goal: to cultivate well-developed persons with comprehensive qualification and ability, who are needed in the modern world. Learning Time: Enrollment is in September each year. Teaching Method: The overseas students have classes with the Chinese students, and the diploma can be awarded after finishing the schemed course, gaining the needed credit hours and passing the thesis oral defense. The degree can be awarded after the permission of the school Degree Committee in accordance with " The Degree Statute of People’s Republic of China " The curriculum include Finance, Finance Management and Practice, Securities Investment and Management, Assets Assessment and Management, Investment and Financial Management
